text.p: McDonald's Corp backed off an idea to guarantee customers it could deliver their orders within 55 seconds of payment, the Wall Street Journal said in Friday's editions.
The reversal came after franchisees around the United States voted against the guarantee, the Journal reported.
Some franchisees said they opposed the campaign because they envisioned hassles with customers and lost profits.
"It's asking too much. People will tend to take advantage," one Texas franchisee said.
The guarantee was to have been offered this summer.
